faqs.question: What is a good Halloween costume for a pregnant woman?
faqs.answer: Pick by trimester. Early on, choose a costume that needs no bump, such as Little Bo Peep or Ada Lovelace; in the second trimester let the bump carry the design, as Humpty Dumpty or a cracked geode; late on, choose a kaftan or a seated character such as the Lady of Shalott.

faqs.question: Is it safe to wear face paint when you're pregnant?
faqs.answer: None of the official pages we checked gives pregnancy-specific Halloween face-paint advice, so ask your midwife or doctor if you're unsure. Health Canada's general cosmetics advice is to patch-test on the inside of the forearm, wash it off after 24 hours and stop if the skin turns red, itchy or blistered.

faqs.question: What shoes should I wear with a pregnancy costume?
faqs.answer: Flats. The NHS back pain in pregnancy page recommends flat shoes to spread your weight evenly, and ACOG notes that extra weight at the front shifts your centre of gravity and raises the risk of falling. Every costume on this page is built to work with flat shoes.

faqs.question: How do I avoid overheating in a costume while pregnant?
faqs.answer: ACOG's exercise FAQ advises avoiding overheating, especially in the first trimester, along with loose clothing and plenty of water. Choose a costume that strips down to a T-shirt, and save fleece kaftans for cold outdoor nights.

faqs.question: What's a comfortable Halloween costume for the third trimester?
faqs.answer: Kaftans and empire-line maxi dresses with nothing at the waist, such as Persephone or the Snow Queen. Two characters, the Lady of Shalott and Miss Havisham, are played sitting down, which helps because ACOG says standing motionless can cause blood to pool in the legs and feet.

faqs.question: What can I wear if I haven't told anyone I'm pregnant yet?
faqs.answer: Choose a costume that doesn't depend on a bump: Little Bo Peep, Glinda the Good, Ada Lovelace, Rip Van Winkle or an old-world cartographer. All five use one loose layer and a prop, so nobody can read a pregnancy into them.

faqs.question: How can I use a Halloween costume to announce a pregnancy?
faqs.answer: Try a seed packet with your due month, a calendar page with the date circled, or a library card stamped 'Due'. Tell the people closest to you first, and remember that a surrogate's announcement belongs to the intended parents.

faqs.question: What are good couple costumes with a baby bump?
faqs.answer: The tortoise and the hare, Newton and the apple, a dandelion clock and the wish-maker, or a darts player and the bullseye all make the bump one half of the joke. For a family, Hey Diddle Diddle casts the bump as the moon and the children as the cat, the dog, and the dish and spoon.

faqs.question: How much does a DIY pregnancy costume cost?
faqs.answer: Our estimates for materials run from about US$10–40 for one person, US$15–40 for a couple set and US$30–60 for a family set. Most builds take 45 minutes to 3 hours.

faqs.question: When is Halloween, and when should I plan a bump costume?
faqs.answer: Halloween is on Saturday 31 October 2026 and Sunday 31 October 2027. Plan early but build late, because a design that fits at 22 weeks may not close at 34, so leave stretch in every costume.

faqs.question: Can I send my bump costume photo to someone far away?
faqs.answer: Yes. SubhSandesh's interactive Halloween card holds up to six photos and a letter for one recipient, and the premium page adds an optional unlock time and a 60-second voice note. 38.5% of our creators password-protect a page before sharing it, which suits an announcement.

article.contentMarkdown:
# Halloween Costumes for Pregnant Women, Sorted by Trimester

The best Halloween costumes for pregnant women match the trimester: costumes that need no bump early on, the bump as the main prop in the middle months, and loose, seated, flat-shoe builds at the end. Below are 24 original ideas with comfort scores, estimated US costs and DIY times. Halloween falls on Saturday 31 October 2026 and Sunday 31 October 2027.

Bump photos usually travel by link, and 48.3% of shared SubhSandesh pages are opened on a phone (platform-wide, not Halloween data). If the photo doubles as an announcement, 38.5% of our creators password-protect a page before sharing it. Every idea works whether you are expecting with a partner, on your own, or carrying for another family as a surrogate.

## How do pregnant Halloween costumes change by trimester?

A pregnancy costume has to fit the body you will have on 31 October, not the one you shop with. Pregnancy is usually split into trimesters of roughly weeks 1–12, 13–27 and 28 to birth.

Decide early: in our nearest festival data, 49.4% of Raksha Bandhan 2026 pages were built on the festival day itself (n = 89, a different festival used only as an analogue). Each idea below lists its weeks and a comfort score from 3 (no waistband, cool fabric, flat shoes) down to 1, with brackets naming what costs a point.

## 24 pregnant Halloween costumes by trimester and comfort

None of these hides the bump; the first group simply suits anyone who has not told people yet. A "partner" in the couple sets can be a sister, a friend or a toddler.

### 1. First trimester or small bump: 5 costumes that need no bump

- **Little Bo Peep:** gingham smock, bonnet and a crook that doubles as a walking stick (any week · comfort 3 · est. US$20–35 · 1 h).
- **Glinda the Good:** pink tulle skirt on a low soft elastic, loose top, star wand (weeks 1–24 · comfort 2, tulle runs warm · est. US$25–40 · 1.5 h).
- **Ada Lovelace:** dark dress, lace collar and punched cards for her 1843 Analytical Engine notes (any week · comfort 2, velvet is warm · est. US$20–40 · 1 h).
- **Rip Van Winkle:** nightshirt, felt beard and a pillow, so a nap stays in character (weeks 1–16 · comfort 3 · est. US$10–20 · 45 min).
- **Old-world cartographer:** hooded cape, a map inked "Here be monsters" and a compass (any week · comfort 2, cape is warm indoors · est. US$20–30 · 1 h).

### 2. Second trimester: 6 costumes where the bump is the prop

- **Humpty Dumpty:** painted face and bow tie on a cream bump, brick-wall leggings (weeks 18–32 · comfort 3 · est. US$15–25 · 2 h).
- **Giant eyeball:** a felt iris centred on a white bump, red yarn veins (weeks 20–34 · comfort 3 · est. US$10–20 · 1.5 h).
- **Cookie jar:** felt cookies on a pale-blue bump, a lid at the neckline and a tag: "Ask before you reach" (weeks 16–30 · comfort 3 · est. US$15–25 · 2 h).
- **Bright-idea light bulb:** a filament drawn on a white bump, a silver ribbed collar as the screw base (weeks 18–32 · comfort 3 · est. US$10–20 · 1 h).
- **Cracked geode:** charcoal dress, a jagged opening painted on the bump in purple glitter (weeks 20–36 · comfort 3 · est. US$20–30 · 2 h).
- **Tumbleweed:** beige dress, twine wrapped loosely over the bump, a "Just drifting through" sign (weeks 16–30 · comfort 2, twine itches · est. US$10–20 · 1.5 h).

### 3. Third trimester: 5 comfort-first costumes, two of them seated

- **Persephone:** empire-line maxi, a flower crown fading to dark leaves and a split felt pomegranate on the bump (weeks 24–40 · comfort 3 · est. US$20–35 · 2 h).
- **The Snow Queen:** ice-blue kaftan and snowflake crown from Andersen's 1844 tale; thermals fit underneath (any week · comfort 3 · est. US$20–35 · 1.5 h).
- **The Lady of Shalott (seated):** nightgown and cracked mirror, played from a chair draped as a boat; caption it with Tennyson's "The mirror crack'd from side to side" (weeks 28–40 · comfort 3 · est. US$15–25 · 2 h).
- **Miss Havisham (seated):** white nightdress, veil, clocks stopped at twenty to nine and an armchair by a cake prop (weeks 28–40 · comfort 3 · est. US$10–20 · 1 h).
- **Cloud nine:** white fleece kaftan, cotton-wool clouds and a felt "9" on the bump (weeks 32–40 · comfort 2, fleece is hot indoors · est. US$15–25 · 1.5 h).

### 4. Couple and family costumes with a bump: 5 sets

- **The tortoise and the hare:** a felt shell over the bump and a "Slow and steady" sash; the partner in ears with a stopwatch (weeks 20–40 · comfort 3 · est. US$25–40 for two · 2 h).
- **Newton and the apple:** the bump in red with a felt leaf; the partner in a wig with a notebook titled "Gravity, draft 1" (weeks 18–40 · comfort 3 · est. US$20–35 for two · 1 h).
- **Dandelion clock and the wish-maker:** tulle pom-poms on the bump as the seed head; the partner carries a jar of wishes (weeks 20–36 · comfort 3 · est. US$15–30 for two · 2 h).
- **Hey Diddle Diddle:** the bump as the moon, a partner as the cow, children as the cat, the dog, and the dish and spoon (weeks 20–40 · comfort 3 · est. US$30–60 per family · 3 h).
- **The darts player and the bullseye:** a dartboard painted on the bump; the partner in a nickname polo (weeks 20–36 · comfort 3 · est. US$15–30 for two · 2 h).

### 5. Pregnancy announcement costumes: 3 ideas, only when you are ready

Tell the people closest to you before a party does it for you. A surrogate's announcement belongs to the intended parents, and some guests may be living through infertility or loss, so a family-only photo is often kinder.

- **Seed packet:** tan tunic printed "Variety: one small human. Sown: [month]. Expected: [due month]." (weeks 12–30 · comfort 3 · est. US$10–20 · 1 h)
- **Countdown calendar page:** a calendar grid, days crossed off, the due date circled in red (weeks 12–36 · comfort 3 · est. US$10–15 · 45 min).
- **Library due-date card:** a paper pocket holding a stamped card: "Due: [month and year]. No renewals." (weeks 12–36 · comfort 3 · est. US$10–15 · 45 min)

## Pregnant costumes compared: trimester, comfort and est. cost

One costume per group, scored as in the lists. Costs are material estimates.

| Trimester | Costume | Comfort score (1–3) | Est. cost (US$) |
|---|---|---|---|
| First or small bump | Glinda the Good | 2 | 25–40 |
| Second | Humpty Dumpty | 3 | 15–25 |
| Third | The Lady of Shalott, seated | 3 | 15–25 |
| Couple or family | The tortoise and the hare | 3 | 25–40 for two |
| Announcement | Seed packet | 3 | 10–20 |

Cost barely moves across trimesters. Comfort does, so the late picks lean on seated characters.

## Safety on the night: heat, shoes, standing and face paint

If your pregnancy is high-risk, ask your midwife or doctor first. This guidance is general, not medical clearance.

**Heat.** The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG) [exercise-in-pregnancy FAQ, updated September 2024,](https://www.acog.org/womens-health/faqs/exercise-during-pregnancy) advises avoiding overheating, especially in the first trimester, and recommends loose clothing and plenty of water. It targets workouts, but parties run warm too, so pick a costume that strips to a T-shirt.

**Shoes and falls.** ACOG notes that extra weight at the front shifts your centre of gravity and raises the risk of falling. The [NHS page on back pain in pregnancy](https://www.nhs.uk/pregnancy/related-conditions/common-symptoms/back-pain/), last reviewed 10 January 2024, recommends flat shoes to spread your weight evenly, so every costume here is built for flats.

**Standing time.** The same ACOG page says standing motionless can cause blood to pool in the legs and feet, and lists feeling dizzy or faint as a warning sign. Plan a chair into the night.

**Face paint, body paint and fake blood.** Health Canada's [advice on using cosmetics safely](https://www.canada.ca/en/health-canada/services/cosmetics/cosmetics-safety.html), dated 28 February 2019, warns that make-up can cause allergic reactions and skin irritation. It suggests a patch test on the inside of the forearm, washed off after 24 hours, and dropping any product that changes in smell, colour or feel. The page is not pregnancy-specific, so treat fake blood and bump paint the same way and use only products made for skin.

## What research says about dressing a pregnant body

A [2022 narrative review of maternity-wear research](https://europepmc.org/article/PMC/PMC9881558) by Shamsaei and colleagues concluded that maternity clothing needs adaptability, comfort and style. It stresses thermal and tactile comfort and easy dressing, the logic behind our scores.

The review also lists minimising "the protrusion of enlarged areas of the body" as a goal. On Halloween we suggest the opposite if you want it: the bump is the costume.

A [2026 interview study by Hannah Griffin](https://uwlpress.uwl.ac.uk/newvistas/article/id/366/) of seven pregnant women aged 30 to 42 found five positive body image themes, including "celebrating the pregnant body". It is a small doctoral-conference study, and participants did not always notice that appreciation in themselves.

## A bump photo for one person: the Halloween card

A bump photo can reach a grandparent-to-be privately. Our [interactive Halloween card](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween) holds up to six photos, a letter and a word to carve on the pumpkin, and its family mode asks "Will you be my favourite little pumpkin?".

They knock three times, wipe fog off portraits to find your photos and read your letter by flashlight; you are emailed when they first answer. For a timed announcement, the [premium Halloween page](https://subhsandesh.in/happy-halloween-premium) adds an optional unlock time with a countdown, a 60-second voice note and a reply box.

## When these costumes, or our card, fall short

Bump-built costumes date fast: a design that fits at 22 weeks may not close at 34. Anyone told to limit standing should skip the party for a sofa photo.

The card is a one-person greeting page with an English-only interface, not a party invitation or a family-wide announcement. If your parents will be in the room on 31 October, telling them face to face beats any link.

## Sources

- Shamsaei et al., *Iranian Journal of Nursing and Midwifery Research*, 18 November 2022.
- Griffin, *New Vistas*, 21 May 2026.
- ACOG, "Exercise During Pregnancy", updated September 2024.
- NHS, "Back pain in pregnancy", reviewed 10 January 2024.
- Health Canada, "Use cosmetics safely", 28 February 2019.
